settings.heading: Where should I start if I am not sure which solution I need?
settings.text: Start with the outcome you need rather than a product name. If you want to run a full compliance program, explore Managed Programs. If you need to solve one testing or training gap, choose the matching solution path above. The comparison table can also help you match your current need with the right starting page.

settings.heading: Can I combine more than one Andatech solution?
settings.text: Yes. Equipment, training, servicing, software and program support can form parts of the same compliance approach. The appropriate combination depends on your sites, roles, existing processes and internal capability.

settings.heading: What is the difference between an individual solution and a Managed Program?
settings.text: An individual solution addresses a defined requirement, such as alcohol testing equipment, drug-screening methods, training or reporting. A Managed Program is the broader pathway when you want ongoing coordination of devices, calibration, training, reporting and program review.

settings.heading: What does the Managed Programs journey cover?
settings.text: It walks through four stages: the Compliance Lifecycle shows the six-stage framework, Scope & Support helps you configure what the program includes, the ROI Calculator lets you estimate indicative value using your own figures, and Partner Model lets you choose a commercial relationship that fits your organisation.

settings.heading: Can Andatech work with our existing equipment and processes?
settings.text: Potentially. A solutions conversation should first establish what is already working, what is compatible and where the gaps sit. Recommendations can then distinguish what may be retained, improved, connected or replaced.

settings.heading: Do all solutions require Andalink software?
settings.text: No. Andalink is presented as an optional connected reporting and evidence layer where it supports the required workflow. The suitability and available integrations should be confirmed against the chosen solution and current systems.

settings.heading: Can we purchase training without changing our equipment?
settings.text: Training & Education is a distinct solution path. The appropriate course or competency pathway depends on the participant's role, testing method, current qualifications and workplace responsibilities.

settings.heading: What information should I prepare before speaking with Andatech?
settings.text: Bring a simple overview of your sites, workforce roles, current testing or compliance process, existing equipment and systems, and the outcome you want to improve. That is enough to guide the first conversation toward the right solution path.
